title: Industrial Electrician - Plant Maintenance

Experience with PLC troubleshooting and electrical maintenance using multimeter and megger testing is preferred.

title: Maintenance Electrician
description: Urgent requirement for Electricians in Pune plant. title: Mechanical Bench Fitter

title: Substation Electrician
